description: Source code implementing the DisplayOzone class for the ANGLE project, providing EGL display functionalities on the Ozone platform with DRM and GBM integration, including buffer management, rendering, and presentation logic.

classes.name: SwapControlData
classes.description: Structure for swap interval control, currently unused.

classes.name: DisplayOzone
classes.description: Class implementing EGL display functionalities for Ozone platform with buffer management, rendering, and presentation.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Class managing EGL buffers, including creation, resizing, and rendering buffers for display.

classes.name: WorkerContextOzone
classes.description: Class representing a worker EGL context for background operations.

methods.name: UnsignedToSigned
methods.description: Converts a uint32_t to EGLint by reinterpret cast.

methods.name: ChooseMode
methods.description: Selects the preferred display mode from a DRM connector.

methods.name: ChooseCRTC
methods.description: Selects a CRTC index compatible with the connector.

methods.name: Buffer::reset
methods.description: Resets and releases resources associated with the buffer.

methods.name: Buffer::resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to specified dimensions, recreating underlying buffers and images.

methods.name: Buffer::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the buffer with a native window or specific dimensions.

methods.name: Buffer::bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds the buffer's EGL image to a texture.

methods.name: Buffer::getTexture
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenGL texture from the buffer's EGL image.

methods.name: Buffer::getDRMFB
methods.description: Returns the DRM framebuffer ID, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: Buffer::createGLFB
methods.description: Creates an OpenGL framebuffer object for rendering.

methods.name: Buffer::framebufferGL
methods.description: Returns a FramebufferGL object wrapping the created GL framebuffer.

methods.name: Buffer::present
methods.description: Presents the buffer on the display, optionally resizing.

methods.name: Buffer::createRenderbuffers
methods.description: Creates GL renderbuffers for color and depth/stencil.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the EGL display, DRM device, and renderer.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::hasUsableScreen
methods.description: Checks if a DRM device has a connected and usable screen.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::pageFlipHandler
methods.description: Handles page flip events for display updates.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::presentScreen
methods.description: Handles buffer presentation and page flip scheduling.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::makeShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader from source code.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::drawWithTexture
methods.description: Draws a buffer's texture onto the screen using OpenGL.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::drawBuffer
methods.description: Draws a buffer and presents it on the screen.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::flushGL
methods.description: Flushes GL commands and manages fences for Mali GPU.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources and shuts down the display.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::createWindowSurface
methods.description: Creates a window surface with a buffer.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::createPbufferSurface
methods.description: Creates a pixel buffer surface.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::createContext
methods.description: Creates a new EGL context sharing the renderer.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::generateConfigs
methods.description: Generates EGL configurations supported by this display.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::testDeviceLost
methods.description: Checks if the device is lost.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::restoreLostDevice
methods.description: Restores a lost device (not implemented).

methods.name: DisplayOzone::destroyNativeContext
methods.description: Destroys a native EGL context.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval (currently a stub).

methods.name: DisplayOzone::generateExtensions
methods.description: Generates supported EGL extensions.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::makeCurrentSurfaceless
methods.description: Makes the context current without a surface.

methods.name: WorkerContextOzone::WorkerContextOzone
methods.description: Constructor for WorkerContextOzone.

methods.name: WorkerContextOzone::~WorkerContextOzone
methods.description: Destructor for WorkerContextOzone, destroys EGL context.

methods.name: WorkerContextOzone::makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the worker EGL context current.

methods.name: WorkerContextOzone::unmakeCurrent
methods.description: Unsets the current EGL context.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::createWorkerContext
methods.description: Creates a worker EGL context.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::initializeFrontendFeatures
methods.description: Initializes frontend features for the renderer.

methods.name: DisplayOzone::populateFeatureList
methods.description: Populates feature list from renderer features.
